title: Ing Talabalita ning Maragul a Albug
intro: Ing indibidwal a ini tinalakad ya bilang asias ning pamagtiis kilub ning dakal a siglu, a mamaus king metung a lipunan a mapaglaban papunta king sala ning katutwan kabang arapan na ing pamaglibak at pamagtaksil. Agyang nanu pa ing sobrang problema ampo ing bigat ning mensahi a milabas kareng henerasyun, ining talasuyu menatili yang matatag keng misyun na angga na inyang mipalabas ya ing tauling kautusan.
clues: Milabas kung siam a ralan at limang pulung banua ban ausan ku la ding memalen ku king dalan ning katuliran, aldo’t bengi, king lihim at king publiku.
Binabala ku la ding memalen ku king masakit a parusa, oneng binili da la ring taliri da karing balugbug da at tinakpan da la ring karelang imalan king kayabangan.
Inutus da kanaku ing gawang maragul a bage lalam ning mapagmasid nang mata ning kanakung Ginu, agyang ala kung akakit a danum.
Kabang magobra ku, dinalan la ding pamuntuk da ring memalen ku at insultuan da ku, oneng sinabi ku karela king e maglambat ikami na ing magsisti karela.
Mekisabi ku para keng sarili kung laman ampo daya para makiabe kanaku, pero pinili da ing manintun lang saup keng bunduk, paniwalan da na iligtas da la keng daragul a danum.
Tinuknang ya ing saken ku king Bunduk ning Judi kaybat nang linukluk ning yatu ing danum na at tinuknang ing uran ning banua.

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
